item.description:
### Changed - **The usage section shows each agent's logo.** Claude's spark, OpenAI's knot and Cursor's cube replace the plain coloured dots, matching how session rows already identify a provider — on the Mac, iPhone and watch. - **iPhone: the usage bars now match the Mac.** They use the full width of the row, line up with the provider line above them, and the reset time sits next to its percentage instead of drifting off to the right.
### Fixed - **iPhone: a usage row with no reset time no longer has a longer bar than the others.** Same defect the Mac had — a window that reports no reset, such as Claude's per-model bar, stretched further right and pushed its percentage out of line.
### Note - The iPhone and watch app also pick up everything the Mac gained since the last companion build: Cursor sessions, Cursor usage, and the git branch on each row.
